reason: A host-lifecycle automation plugin that intercepts selected bash self-termination commands and provides confirmed graceful exit or restart workflows, while explicitly operating as a UX layer rather than a security boundary.

summaries.zh: 用于防止智能体意外终止 DeepSeek Harness 主机进程，并通过确认令牌提供受控的优雅退出与重启流程。
summaries.en: Prevents accidental DeepSeek Harness host termination by intercepting selected bash commands and providing token-confirmed graceful exit and restart workflows.

capabilities: Intercepts selected bash commands that could terminate the host process
Provides token-confirmed graceful host exit and restart tools
Injects guidance after intercepted commands and records an audit trail
